content:
Ravi: Hey team — opened a small docs PR for the private installer quickstart + SDK example that we promised for on-prem customers: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Ravi: Main fixes are: (1) network port matrix link was broken, (2) KMS config example for pkcs11 was missing env var names, (3) short note about air-gapped mirrors for RPMs.
Ana: Thanks! I skimmed — the port matrix link does 404 for the `vpc/ports.md` anchor. I can push a doc redirect or fix the anchor. @Tyler can you confirm the anchor name?
Tyler: Anchor changed in the last refactor — should be `vpc-network-ports`. Will update the link in the PR. :+1:
Maria: Re: KMS env vars — the snippet uses `PKCS11_MODULE_PATH` but our SDK expects `PKCS11_MODULE` in the latest release. We should include both and call out which SDK versions accept which.
Ravi: Good catch. I'll add a compatibility note and a tiny table. Also adding a code snippet for the minimal JS SDK config for private deployments.
Ana: For the airgap note, please include the checksum verification step and `gpg --verify` example. Someone hit corrupted mirror tarballs last week.
Ravi: Will do. Draft snippet I'm planning to add (feel free to tweak):

```
// minimal redwood-private SDK config for on-prem
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood.Client({
  baseURL: 'https://private.example.internal',
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY,
  kms: {
    provider: 'pkcs11',
    modulePath: process.env.PKCS11_MODULE || process.env.PKCS11_MODULE_PATH,
    tokenLabel: process.env.HSM_TOKEN,
  }
});
```

Tyler: That looks good. Suggest adding a note about `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` for the PKCS#11 module on CentOS vs Ubuntu. And maybe a one-liner systemd drop-in to set it.
Maria: Also add a short HSM permission bullet: the installer runs as `redwood` user so the PKCS#11 module file needs read access for that user or group.
Ana: I'll fix the port anchor and add the checksum/GPG snippet. One small UX ask: can we keep the example short and link to the longer migration guide for customers migrating from cloud KMS -> on-prem HSM? We have that doc but it isn't linked anywhere.
Ravi: Yes linking to migration guide sounds right. I'll add a link to `/private/migration/cloud-to-hsm.md` and add a note to the release notes.
Ravi: Last ask: can docs-bot run linkcheck on this branch? I want to catch any other broken anchors before merge.
docs-bot: scheduled linkcheck for branch `ravi/private-sdk-snippet` — results will post as a follow-up comment. :robot_face:
Ana: Thanks — assigning myself to the link anchor fix and the GPG snippet.
Tyler: I'll add the LD_LIBRARY_PATH systemd drop-in and test PKCS#11 on Ubuntu 22.04.
Maria: I'll add the HSM permission note and confirm which SDK versions accept `PKCS11_MODULE` vs `PKCS11_MODULE_PATH`.
Ravi: Awesome — if all good let's try to merge by EOD tomorrow. I'll mark the PR as ready for review after these edits. :shipit:
